title: Nutty Peruvian Chicken Aji De Gallina
description: A jammy, crumbly, indulgent Peruvian dish featuring almond extract, this recipe is a low-sodium friendly version of the traditional Aji De Gallina.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken breast until browned on both sides.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes or until cooked through.
In a blender or food processor, grind the chopped walnuts into a fine crumb.
In a large saucepan, combine the heavy cream, almond extract, and grated parmesan cheese, and stir over low heat until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Stir in the ground walnuts and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Flake the cooked chicken into the walnut sauce and stir to combine.
Serve the chicken and sauce over the cooked rice.
